amendsOnly: The paragraph beginning 170s internal covers the entire G0 protocol including generation. No descriptor, oracle arithmetic, candidate price, bit limit, tolerance, fixedcasecount or cost gate is changed.

protocols.M0: Separate reference materialization: pinned source/tools and fixed32 descriptors; 170s internal/180s external. No candidate call. Generates requests and oracle before candidate source/data seal.
protocols.G0: Separate candidate32-pair arithmetic plus independent audit, authentication, IO and cleanup: shared170s internal/180s external and ONE global2M meter; input generated by M0, sealed before call.
protocols.B: One6frame full reference bank only after actualA/G0PASS, separately170/180s, one conservativecostdecision.

why: Materialized bytes must be sealed before the candidate call. Author review/sealing latency cannot honestly be described as inside the same uninterrupted170s census. Each actual numerical command remains bounded; no deadline is reset inside a protocol. Do not claim M0+G0 are one170s protocol.
